Differentiable Rendering With Reparameterized Volume Sampling
a differentiable volume rendering algorithm (18) with the MLP-based fields to produce images, they minimize the discrepancy between the output images and a set of reference images to learn a scene representation. The algorithm we propose is a drop-in replacement for the volume rendering algorithm used in NeRF (20) and follow-ups.
